'''Yurrita''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was stationed aboard [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yurrita appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Hoth Modification Commendations Vendor on Carrick Station, though she was later relabeled as a Level 38 Modification Commendations Vendor.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Yurrita now also appears on a number of worlds in the place of the original armor, weapon, and mods vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
